versions.changelog:
Initial release with complete freelance business operating system:

- Comprehensive step-by-step frameworks for positioning, pricing, proposals, and service packaging.
- Practical tools and scorecards for niche selection and pricing strategy.
- Ready-to-use scripts and playbooks for client outreach, rate increases, and packaging services.
- Guidance on building a sustainable solo business, transitioning from side-hustle to full-time, and scaling recurring revenue.
- Covers all stages: from landing first clients to growing a six-figure freelance practice.
